Two independent orbit and parity enumerators reproduce exact Smith factors d1:1^6, d2:1^15, d3:1^49,3^5,6; hence H2=Z/6 plus five copies Z/3 and H3=Z^15, with H1=0. The stable-range chessboard shellability theorem makes the original 3-dimensional complex simply connected. Three-cycles fixing vertices generate A4, so Armstrong gives trivial quotient pi1. The simply connected 2-skeleton is a wedge of 2-spheres; 3-cell attaching maps classify by integer degree, and Smith diagonalization gives exactly one 6-Moore space, five 3-Moore spaces, and fifteen 3-spheres. value.rationale: The 4x7 case is not an arbitrary small board: it is the first four-row chessboard in the full-shellability/Cohen-Macaulay range. Its cover is a 225-fold wedge of S3 with no torsion, but the natural tetrahedral even-row geometric quotient has simultaneous 2-primary and 3-primary pi2 and fifteen free H3 classes. The exact mixed Moore-space wedge classifies the entire homotopy type, an integral invariant neither rational characters nor the known cover topology supplies. This natural first stable-width boundary makes the finite computation mathematically motivated and reusable.
